content: Wofuŋte dâŋ racne mi eocmu
Jorocfâc-nane, ŋoŋere papia ši qâreŋkehape jajahec ekac. No maŋŋeŋic wiwickepe mitidâŋ mi mana sifuckehuc sâcne mana taraniŋte qâreŋke-ŋareekopac hâcne.
Eme ŋoŋe tiri porofete mârâc jaha dâŋ mumbiŋ irec mecne â aposolofâc-ŋeŋic nâŋe Wofuŋ â bâbâpiaŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋazambeŋ i mecne mâmâc manasuhuc junšepieŋ.
Ehuc qanaŋ šiŋuc mana sanaŋkenšepieŋ: Dameŋ bembeŋkezo eme ŋic âke sisicne fuarâ mufec muriŋ dâŋ muhuc sasec gie-jeŋicte hešâkiriŋkerâ juniŋmu.
Ehuc šiŋuc muniŋmu: “Wofuŋ risieocte mukicne fârine weni? Kâcɋenefâc-nâŋec hâmombiŋ, ehame wiac sasawa mâreŋ fuaweckonecteaŋ fowarehuc juwec iŋucnea fohuc jukac.”
Jaŋe fuŋne šiŋuc mana-bipiehuc dâŋ i mueŋgopieŋ: Sambâŋ e mârâc jaha fuawec â mâreŋ e iŋuc jaha. I Anutu dâŋticnere opâonec fuarâ opâheckoaŋ fowec.
Eme šâhec opâzia ŋic â wiac sasawa qâuruc-jopahuc bâsirowec-jopawec.
Á sambâŋ â mâreŋ ši fokopirec ine Anuture dâŋzi sakarec-jofame šocte biŋe erâ fokopirec. Okac dameŋ maickeme ŋic sâqocne jaŋe sipirickeniŋte irec woŋec fokopirec hâcne.
Wofuŋ e nâŋâcnere erâ dameŋ-ticne bâšoraekac
Jorocfâc-nane, wiac moc ši kâuc mi banšepieŋ: Wofuŋ e šoaŋ gie bapa mocjahare maname jare I tauseŋ tinac eekac â jara I tauseŋ irec maname šoaŋ gie bapa mocjaha tinac eekac.

Wofuŋ e dâŋ muwec irec fârine bâfuaocte bititiehuc dameŋ mi bâšoraekac, ŋic gâcnezi manapie iŋuc tinac eekac. Aricne, e ŋic gâcnezi sipirickenšipiŋte ŋoŋere erâ woŋec juekac. E ŋic mâmâc sasawa maŋjeŋic bârisie-fâreniŋte muekac hâcne.
Sambaŋ â mâreŋ sirowezokopirec

Wofuŋte dameŋ e râsi fisieŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha ututuŋ maickeocmu. Maickeme sambâŋ e fânâŋ sâko ehuc siroweocmu, â wiac hohonene sasawa i šoczi šafâreocmu, erâ wâc mâreŋ â fainao wiac bâfuakicne i šoczi šâseŋkeocmu.
Wiac sasawa sirowe-fâreocmu, irec ŋoŋe pectâc juhuc miti sisirombe faio bajunšepieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Anutu dameŋ-ticne hejâpehuc harac huacbuc enšepieŋ. Maickeme hâcne sambâŋ e šoczi šârârâŋneocmu, â wiac hohonene sasawa i šocbâruŋko šâtâmireocmu.
Nâŋâc ine sambâŋ ɋâricne â mâreŋ ɋâricne fuaocte biŋe qanârekicne, irec woŋec jueŋgopeneŋ, eme ira tiŋne jujuzi sâcke-fârerâ fozokac.
Mumutara â jambuŋdâŋ
Jorocfâc-nane, ŋoŋe wiac iŋucnere woŋec juhuc ere maio maŋfuru â bahacmâc juniŋte wawariehuc wamao jupie honec-ŋopame sâckezejec.
Erâ Wofuŋ-nâŋeczi dameŋ-ticne bâšorame munšepieŋ, bâpiaŋ-nâpoocte ekac. Âgo biaŋ-nâŋec Paulo e maŋɋârâŋ-ticnere sâcko dâŋ irecteaŋ qâreŋke-ŋarewec.

E papia qâreŋkehuc sâc dâŋ i mufua rawec. Papia-ticnao dâŋ gâcne fokac irec fuŋne qame hukicne. Eme dâŋ iŋucne i ŋic mutucne â biric borocne jaŋe musifuckeeŋgopieŋ. Erâ i ere papiare sawa mâcne, miti papia gâcnere mâmâc ehuc sisipiric maickeeŋgopieŋ.
Âgo biaŋfâc-nane, uŋdâŋ qanaŋ ŋazakicnere ŋic kosa jujune jaŋere mumusifuczi maŋŋeŋic bâŋgoroŋkeme dockenšipiŋte sawaŋ-ŋeŋic qahuc junšepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ â bâbâpiaŋ-nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere aki anonocko â fuŋne-ticne mana utuckehuc soka sanaŋ enšepieŋ. E eri tatamac i šiŋuczia focnekac erâ juju sanaŋ dameŋko iŋuc jaha focne rahuc juzokac.
